Reading order: clear. Captions sit at the top left of each panel in a 2x2 grid, followed by a full-width bottom tier: 09-1 caption then label, 09-2 caption, 09-3 caption, 09-4 caption then the NOW · A-31 label at the upper right where the TV is planned, then 09-5's balloon (tail to Ananya) and the bottom caption. No two non-consecutive text items sit close enough to be read out of turn.

Time cues: 'On the day' in 09-2 follows the reminder in 09-1 and reads naturally as the appointed follow-up day. The scene plan backs it up with morning light at the familiar entrance. 'As usual' in 09-4 calls back to 04-1 ('Soon, his slot comes up', NOW · A-12). The new token A-31 marks a different visit. Both cues work.

First-reader concern (Ravi does not answer 'Welcome back'): a silent reaction is acceptable only if it is drawn. The 09-5 scene says only that he 'sits down opposite her, empty-handed', and the emotion field ('Warm, efficient') describes Ananya. Nothing tells the image model to give Ravi a readable reaction. See issue 1.

First-reader concern (Meera's role in Panel C is unexplained): the caption 'No queue at the desk' is the reason she is shown. But the 09-3 scene says only 'Meera works at the reception desk in the background, not needed'. It does not say that no patients are queuing at her desk, and 'not needed' is not something an artist can draw. See issue 2.

Continuity in the plan is sound. In 09-1 the phone is in Ravi's right hand. In 09-2 it is in his shirt pocket and his hands are empty. In 09-3 it is in his right hand at the QR stand. In 09-4 it is in his lap, and in 09-5 it is put away. Dropping his usual shoulder bag in 09-2 supports 'empty-handed'. The bag comes back in 10-1 (a later trip) and 10-4 (the symbolic closing), which does not contradict page 09.

Note for the artwork stage, not an issue now: the source calls FOLLOW-UP REMINDER a label 'on the phone', but the plan puts it on the wall at the upper left. Keep Ravi's phone near that label so the label reads as the phone's message.

Production caution outside this storyboard: assets/panels/09-1.png still holds the old vision train art, the same as 10-1.png, and assets/panels/09-2.png to 09-4.png appear to be the old vision panels (renumber-2026-11-12c.json maps them to 10-x). workflow/review/page-09.png is the stale pre-Request-5 vision page ('Tomorrow, care may take us beyond our hometown.'). assets/page-09.review.json and stage-reviews artwork-09-*.json and lettering-09.json are probably stale as well. issues.problem: 09-5 gives Ravi no visible reaction to 'Welcome back, Ravi. Your results are already here.' The scene and emotion fields describe only Ananya. The first reader flagged the missing reply, and a silent answer works only if the art shows one. Add a concrete reaction to the 09-5 scene, emotion and production fields, for example: Ravi smiles back, relaxed and at ease, glancing at the history on her tablet with his empty hands resting on his knee and the chair arm.

In 09-3 Meera's background role is not explained in a drawable way. 'Meera works at the reception desk in the background, not needed' does not show the caption's claim 'No queue at the desk'. State that no one is queuing at the reception desk, and that Meera, free of a queue, is busy with other work at her monitor (or glances up with a small smile). Then the reader sees why she is there, and the art shows the clinic saving staff time.

The reader also found 'On the day' and 'As usual' clear, and I agree. Two concerns remain unresolved in the plan: Ravi's silent reaction in 09-5 and Meera's unexplained presence in 09-3. Neither scene description yet gives the art what it needs, so the status is changes-requested.
